scope: Independent numerical and actual-wire review of periodic HATCH conversion and generated standalone SPLINE curves
method: Homogeneous de Boor recurrence and manually constructed OCS frame, using actual producer DXF control/weight/knot arrays. No owner verifier helper or manifest expected sample data imported. Actual standalone arrays and emitted netDxf evaluation samples compared independently.
limits: 48 legacy compact HATCH drawings (576 periodic packets) are explicitly storage-only; their separately emitted canonical standalone drawings are audited.
This review covers twelve degree1/2/3 periodic producer packets in all six supported profiles, both transports, both plane choices, both link modes and both retained packet forms.
Native CAD execution and other periodic knot layouts remain unqualified.
provisional: provisional-result.json is historical setup evidence only; final-result supersedes it and counts are not additive.
